Definition: a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard)
BiblicalUsage: 1) reed, stalk, bone, balances; 1a) stalk; 1b) water-plant, reed; 1c) calamus (aromatic reed); 1d) derived meanings; 1d1) measuring-rod; 1d2) reed (as unit of measure-6 cubits); 1d3) beam (of scales-for scales themselves); 1d4) shaft (of lampstand); 1d5) branches (of lampstand); 1d6) shoulder-joint
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
